title: SpaceX Reports Smooth Preparations at LC-39A Ahead of Starship's First Florida Launch
detail: SpaceX reported that preparations at Launch Complex 39A at Kennedy Space Center in Florida are proceeding well ahead of Starship's first-ever launch from the East Coast. The debut Florida launch would mark a major operational milestone, adding Atlantic-facing launch capability to the program alongside the existing Starbase facility in Boca Chica, Texas.
